title: How to Best Use Tokens on Unreal 5.8 MCP and Claude
author: TurtlesBlubber
selftext:
I'm working on a game in UE 5.8 and trying to figure out how to make the best use of Claude without pushing up against my usage limits. 

  
As a background, I'm an Android developer, but only started using agentic coding in the last few months. It was a pretty straightforward transition as I already understood the codebase, knew what to look for, and had the skills to write focused prompts. At work, there are also several Android-specific skills that help standardize workflows.

  
Game development has been a different experience entirely. I had a tiny bit of Unreal knowledge, but not nearly the same as Android. I'm using Claude with Unreal MCP, and I'm still learning Unreal itself, so I don't have the same ability to catch mistakes as I do with Android. 

  
I'm currently on the $20/month Claude plan and I've managed to exhaust my daily limit twice. I don't run into that mistake at work, partially due to the enterprise plan, but I believe it's also partially due to my knowledge of Android. 

  
I'm trying to figure out how to build a more efficient workflow, and I have a few questions.:  
\* Are there custom skills you've found useful for Unreal development? 

\* are there ways to configure Unreal MCP to be more efficient? I'm not sure how much I'm wasting solely by using the MCP out of the box

\* how do you break work into normally sized tasks? I tend to write a planning document with Claude, and then let Claude do its thing with the caveat to "ask questions"

\* how do you organize your [CLAUDE.md](http://CLAUDE.md) document and other documentation? I've found success using /clear in between tasks, but I don't know if there are other best practices with retaining good project context without loading \*too much\* into each session. 

\* I'm currently using Blueprints, as I started the game by hand, but I also wonder if I should just let Unreal do C++

  
I'd really appreciate any advice or examples that worked well for all of you. Thanks!

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: Sounds like a great question for Claude

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: Also, at the $20 plan you arent going to get much when using the Unreal MCP. You honestly need the $100 and that is not going to be enough. I am using the $200 max and have to hold back in order to not run out of usage within 1-2 days.
